summary: Grupo Aval filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine board-level personnel change. On August 12, 2026, the Board of Directors approved the appointment of Ms. Lined Johanna Ramírez Borborán as Internal Audit Manager, effective immediately, replacing Mr. Luis Alfonso Fajardo, who resigned to pursue other professional opportunities. No financial terms, transaction structure, or strategic implications are disclosed. This is a standard executive appointment announcement, not a special situation. The departure is voluntary and not itself a market-moving event, so it does not qualify as a forced management change. The filing contains no deal terms, advisors, or risk-arbitrage elements.
